notes: Modified cash basis. Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (p4). Transfers: the Total Governmental Funds column prints no transfer amounts (98,762 in/out between governmental funds eliminated), so transfers_in/out null (as FY2023/FY2024 use Total-column figures); fund-column transfers stay in detail. Bond and loan proceeds 405,000 printed under other financing sources -> debt_proceeds. Governmental roll-forward on fund balance: 626,287 + 1,176,867 - 1,184,529 + 405,000 = 1,023,625. Beginning governmental cash not printed (budget schedule p9 prints all-funds cash only: 1,451,776 / 1,906,272). ending_cash from government-wide governmental cash lines (p1); governmental funds statement p3 prints different cash/claim-on-cash figures (total assets 6,213,535), so the balance sheet uses the government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1, includes capital assets and debt). Business-type from basic proprietary statement p6 Totals (agrees with Statement of Activities p2): 1,488,667 + 559,389 - 482,553 = 1,565,503; no transfers. Cash flow statements p7/p12 modified cash basis, proprietary left null (as later years). Budgetary all-funds schedule (p9) combines governmental and utility funds, not recorded in detail. Detail: nonmajor combining schedule (p10, 6 funds) and supplementary proprietary statement by fund (p11, as FY2023/FY2024; figures differ from p6, see report_discrepancies). Rescue Fund 'Transfers out' 1,877 printed without parentheses and added to fund balance. Major governmental funds (General, Street, Park, Sales Tax) have no own schedule. Read pages 1-12 of 12
